arguments.sql: SELECT o.order_date, o.status, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Fonderie Vasseur SARL') AND o.id = 136 GROUP BY o.id

arguments.subject: Réponse à votre commande n° 136
